headline: U.S. Cybersecurity Director Ousted Following Hack of USDA and FBI Systems
summary: White House cybersecurity director Sean Cairncross was removed from his post following reports that the U.S. Department of Agriculture and the FBI suffered cyber breaches. Department of Defense CIO Kirsten Davies will temporarily assume leadership.
why: U.S. federal cybersecurity oversight directly affects corporate defense contracting standards and federal IT security mandates.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: A leadership change follows high-profile cyber intrusions into federal cabinet agencies.
